messages.subject: New GSOC 2011 proposal
parts:
Greetings all,

I was forwarded an email from a colleague soliciting R- related
project proposals for this years GSOC. I went ahead and added a
proposal to the R WIki (http://rwiki.sciviews.org/doku.php?
id=developers:projects:gsoc2011) titled yarrcache. It's related to a
project I've been working on for some time now, but had yet to publish
until recently. I'd be happy to discuss the proposal with list
members.

Best,
Matt

--
Matthew S Shotwell
Assistant Professor
Department of Biostatistics
Vanderbilt University
